title: Membership Tenure and the Northgate Delivery & Installation Mileage Amount
content:
**What tenure discount applies to the mileage amount of a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment?**

A tenure discount is taken off the mileage amount once, according to how long the membership presented on the purchase being delivered has been open, counted in whole months from its opened date (as Northgate Memberships records it) to today:

- a presented membership opened 120 or more whole months before today takes 10 percent off;
- one opened 60 to 119 whole months before today takes 5 percent off;
- one opened fewer than 60 whole months before today takes nothing off.

**What is the mileage amount?**

The miles charged multiplied by the per-mile fee they are charged at. The discount is a percentage of that amount, taken once.

**When is the amount rounded?**

Only the final amount is rounded, to the cent: the percentage comes off the unrounded mileage amount.

**Which membership's opened date is used?**

That of the membership presented on the purchase being delivered.

**Where are the tenure boundaries?**

| Whole months since the opened date | Discount |
|---|---|
| 120 | 10 percent |
| 119 | 5 percent |
| 60 | 5 percent |
| 59 | Nothing |

**Hypothetical figure.** A mileage amount of $40.00 on a membership opened 130 whole months ago becomes $40.00 less 10 percent, $36.00; on one opened 70 whole months ago, $38.00; on one opened 30 whole months ago, $40.00.
